name: Equation term build
purpose: Build a formula term by term while a figure shows each part; the whole equation is laid out first so nothing reflows, and the result is ringed.

inputs.name: rise
inputs.description: rise of each term on reveal

implementation.api: Studio.comp.equation(parent, {terms}, {rise, ringColor}) -> {show, reveal(tl, i, at), build(tl, times[] | {at, gap}), ring(tl, i, at, {duration 0.4}), exit}

layout_notes: Inline-flex row in the display face at 7u; place it under or beside the figure it explains.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-equation-trace/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
